semantics.restart_same_backend: bitwise equal complete parameter/optimizer/EMA state and cursor

unconstrained_routing.selection: report agreements and top2/top3 margins; investigate every disagreement exceeding measured probability error bound

rejection_policy: These gates are prospective. Failure is retained and investigated; no threshold relaxation to turn a failed candidate into a pass.
